description_en: Use this API to submit a task to generate a dynamic image
description_zh: 本接口用于提交生成动态图像的任务
kebab_example: aliyun ice submit-dynamic-image-job --input Type=OSS Media=oss://bucket/object.mp4 --biz-output Type=Media Media=000096e8864746a0b6f30000 --template-config '{"OverwriteParams":{},"TemplateId":"000096e8864746a0b6f30000"}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitDynamicImageJob

fields.help_en:
The input media resource.

If `Type` is set to `OSS`, specify the OSS URL of the input file.

If `Type` is set to `Media`, specify the media asset ID.

An OSS URL must be in one of the following formats:

`oss://bucket/object`

`http(s)://bucket.oss-[RegionId].aliyuncs.com/object`

In these formats, `bucket` is the name of an OSS bucket in the same region as the current project, and `object` is the file path.

The specified OSS bucket must be registered in IMS https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/609918.html
fields.help_zh:
输入媒体。

当Type为OSS时填入OSS地址。

Type为Media时填入媒资ID。

OSS地址规则为：

oss://bucket/object

http(s)://bucket.oss-[RegionId].aliyuncs.com/object

其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的OSS bucket名称，object为文件路径。

URL中的 OSS bucket 需要先添加到IMShttps://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/609918.html后再使用
fields.name: media

fields.help_en:
The type of the job input. Valid values:

`OSS`: An Object Storage Service (OSS) file URL.

`Media`: A media asset ID
fields.help_zh:
输入类型，取值：

OSS：OSS文件地址。

Media：媒资ID
fields.name: type

fields.help_en:
The destination OSS URL for the output file. This parameter is required when `Type` is set to `OSS`. The URL must be in one of the following formats:

`oss://bucket/object`

`http(s)://bucket.oss-[regionId].aliyuncs.com/object`

In these formats, `bucket` is the name of an OSS bucket in the same region as the current project, and `object` is the file path.

The specified OSS bucket must be registered in IMS https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/609918.html
fields.help_zh:
输出媒体，支持OSS地址和媒资ID两种。
OSS地址规则为

oss://bucket/object
http(s)://bucket.oss-[regionId].aliyuncs.com/object

其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的OSS bucket名称，object为文件路径。

URL中的 OSS bucket 需要先添加到IMShttps://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/609918.html后再使用
fields.name: media

fields.help_en:
The type of the job output. Valid values:

`OSS`: The output is an OSS file.

`Media`: The output is a new media asset
fields.help_zh:
输出类型，取值：

OSS：oss文件地址。

Media：媒资ID
fields.name: type

fields.help_en:
The animated image format. Valid values:

`gif`

`webp`
fields.help_zh:
动图格式，取值：
gif。
webp
fields.name: format

fields.help_en: The height of the output animated image. Valid range: [128, 4096]
fields.help_zh: 输出动图高度。取值范围：[128, 4096]
fields.name: height

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable adaptive orientation based on the long and short edges of the video. Valid values:

true: Enables adaptive orientation.

false: Disables adaptive orientation.

Default value: true.

When enabled, this mode sets the output width to the source video's long edge and the output height to its short edge. For a portrait video, its height is treated as the long edge and its width as the short edge
fields.help_zh:
是否开启横竖屏自适应（长短边模式）。取值：

true：开启横竖屏自适应。
false：关闭横竖屏自适应。

默认值：true。
转码输出的宽对应输入片源的长边（竖屏为片源的高），高对应输入视频的短边（竖屏为片源的宽）
fields.name: long_short_mode

fields.help_en:
The scan mode. Valid values:

interlaced: Interlaced scanning.

progressive: Progressive scanning. This is the default value
fields.help_zh:
扫描模式。可取值：

interlaced：交叉扫描。

progressive：顺序扫描。默认值
fields.name: scan_mode

fields.help_en:
The duration of the video segment to be processed.

Format: `hh:mm:ss[.SSS]` or `sssss[.SSS]`.

Valid range: `[00:00:00.000,23:59:59.999]` or `[0.000,86399.999]`
fields.name: duration

fields.help_en:
The end time of the video segment to be processed. If this parameter is set, the `Duration` parameter is ignored.

Format: `hh:mm:ss[.SSS]` or `sssss[.SSS]`.

Valid range: `[00:00:00.000,23:59:59.999]` or `[0.000,86399.999]`
fields.help_zh:
截尾时长，表示切掉尾部的若干时长。设置此值时，参数Duration失效。
格式：`hh:mm:ss[.SSS]`或`sssss[.SSS]`。
取值范围 ：`[00:00:00.000,23:59:59.999]`或`[0.000，86399.999]`
fields.name: end

fields.help_en:
The start time of the video segment to be processed.

Format: `hh:mm:ss[.SSS]` or `sssss[.SSS]`.

Valid range: `[00:00:00.000,23:59:59.999]` or `[0.000,86399.999]`
fields.name: seek

fields.help_en: Specifies the time range of the video to process for the animated image
fields.name: time_span

fields.help_en: The width of the output animated image. Valid range: [128, 4096]
fields.help_zh: 输出动图宽度。取值范围：[128, 4096]
fields.name: width

fields.help_en: The priority of the job. Valid range: [1, 10]. A higher value indicates a higher priority. Default value: 6
fields.help_zh: 优先级，1-10，默认6。数值越大，优先级越高
fields.name: priority
